title: A flaw has been found in subhajitkhan online-clinic-management-system up to e9ee77a8827a1446220fa07ee693dc4d9a29a578. (CVE-2026-115249)
description: A vulnerability exists in the subhajitkhan online-clinic-management-system affecting the Appointment Booking component's patappointtime.php file. Improper input validation of the day/time/appdate arguments allows remote attackers to manipulate these inputs. The flaw has a CVSS score of 4.6, indicating low severity. An exploit has been published, but there is no vendor response or patch available yet.
aiSummary: The subhajitkhan online-clinic-management-system up to commit e9ee77a8827a1446220fa07ee693dc4d9a29a578 contains an input validation flaw in an unknown function within patappointtime.php related to Appointment Booking. Manipulation of the day/time/appdate parameters can be performed remotely, potentially leading to limited impact such as integrity or availability issues. The vulnerability is tracked as CVE-2026-115249 with a CVSS 3.1 base score of 4.6 (AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:R/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:L). The project has been informed but has not issued a fix or response. Exploit code is publicly available.
aiImpact: The vulnerability allows remote attackers with low privileges and requiring user interaction to manipulate appointment booking parameters, causing improper input validation. This may result in limited integrity and availability impacts, but no confidentiality loss. The CVSS score reflects a low severity risk.
